trace.title: Rendimiento neto del trabajo antes de otros gastos
trace.reference: Ley 35/2006 (LIRPF) art. 19.2.a. Art. 20 measures the reducción on this figure, before the art. 19.2.f otros gastos

trace.title: Rendimiento neto del trabajo
trace.reference: config irpf.trabajo.otrosGastos; Ley 35/2006 (LIRPF) art. 19.2.f, limited to the rendimiento íntegro less the other deductible expenses

trace.title: Rendimiento neto de la actividad
trace.reference: SPEC-002 step 2, business rule 7; config irpf.actividad.dificilJustificacion. Gastos include the RETA cuota, a deductible expense of the titular (AEAT Manual práctico Renta 2025, cap. 7)

trace.title: Reducción por inicio de una actividad económica
trace.reference: Ley 35/2006 (LIRPF) art. 32.3, first period with a positive net (primer período impositivo en que sea positivo); config irpf.actividad.inicioActividad; AEAT Manual práctico Renta 2025, cap. 7, fase 3. Art. 32.2.1º is ruled out for this profile (SPEC-003 §0): it requires every sale to go to one client or the taxpayer to be a TRADE (2.º b), at least 70 % of ingresos under retención, which foreign payers never withhold (2.º f), and no employment income (2.º e). Art. 32.2.3º, for rentas no exentas below 12,000 including the activity's, is not applied, and art. 32.1 (irregular income) has no input here; leaving either out can only overstate the net

trace.title: Reducción por trabajo, trabajo solo
trace.reference: config irpf.trabajo.reduccion; Ley 35/2006 (LIRPF) art. 20, where the third band starts from the second band's value at t2; business rule 6. Otras rentas are the activity's rendimiento neto before its art. 32.3 reduction (AEAT Manual práctico Renta 2025, cap. 3, fase 3), the only income other than employment this calculation is given

trace.title: Reducción por trabajo, con la actividad
trace.reference: config irpf.trabajo.reduccion; Ley 35/2006 (LIRPF) art. 20, where the third band starts from the second band's value at t2; business rule 6. Otras rentas are the activity's rendimiento neto before its art. 32.3 reduction (AEAT Manual práctico Renta 2025, cap. 3, fase 3), the only income other than employment this calculation is given

trace.title: Base liquidable general, trabajo solo
trace.reference: Ley 35/2006 (LIRPF) art. 48 and 50: a negative balance is not taxed

trace.title: Cuota íntegra estatal, trabajo solo
trace.reference: Ley 35/2006 (LIRPF) art. 56.2 and 63.1; config irpf.escalaEstatal, irpf.minimos.contribuyente

trace.title: Cuota íntegra autonómica (VC), trabajo solo
trace.reference: Ley 35/2006 (LIRPF) art. 56.3 and 74.1, business rule 9; config regions.VC. The mínimo is the region's own (minimosOverride), or the state's where the region approved none

trace.title: Base liquidable general, trabajo más actividad
trace.reference: Ley 35/2006 (LIRPF) art. 48 and 50: a negative balance is not taxed

trace.title: Cuota íntegra estatal, trabajo más actividad
trace.reference: Ley 35/2006 (LIRPF) art. 56.2 and 63.1; config irpf.escalaEstatal, irpf.minimos.contribuyente

trace.title: Cuota íntegra autonómica (VC), trabajo más actividad
trace.reference: Ley 35/2006 (LIRPF) art. 56.3 and 74.1, business rule 9; config regions.VC. The mínimo is the region's own (minimosOverride), or the state's where the region approved none

trace.title: Cuota íntegra que añade la actividad
trace.reference: Set-aside estimator spec (#2), marginal rate: the activity income is taxed at the rates it reaches on top of the employment income, including any reducción por trabajo it destroys

trace.title: Tipo marginal en la base con la actividad
trace.reference: Ley 35/2006 (LIRPF) art. 63.1 and 74.1: the rate of the tranche of each scale that the next euro of base falls in

trace.title: Pagos fraccionados del Modelo 130 del ejercicio
trace.formula: Σ Modelo 130 a ingresar over the year = 4896.19
trace.reference: Modelo130Calculator at config modelo130.rate. Retenciones on activity invoices are not credited here; they are zero for foreign payers (SPEC-003 §0)

trace.title: Último día para presentar la declaración anual
trace.reference: config calendar.renta, calendar.holidays, regions.VC.holidays; a last day that is a Saturday, a Sunday or a national or regional holiday moves to the next working day (Orden EHA/672/2007 art. 7 for Modelo 130; Ley 39/2015 art. 30.2, 30.5 and 30.6, supletoria under its DA 1ª.2.a and LGT art. 97.b); municipal holidays where the taxpayer lives are not applied, so the date shown can be early but never late

trace.title: Lo que la declaración anual pedirá además del Modelo 130
trace.reference: Assumes the employer's retenciones settle the tax on the employment income alone, so only the activity's share is left. Conservative (#2): a refund is not counted on, no deducciones (SPEC-006) are applied, and the LIRPF art. 32.2.3º reduction of the activity net is not applied
